_comment: Justification channel for scripts/check/check-test-masking.mjs (npm run check:test-masking). Each entry records WHY a gate finding (test-file-deleted / assert-reduction) on the current PR diff is legitimate, as structured data instead of narrative inside test files. Contract: a finding whose {path, kind} matches an entry with a non-empty reason is printed as `justified (recorded: <reason>)` instead of ✗ (review stays visible); a finding with no matching entry fails exactly as before (✗ + exit 1); entries that no longer match any finding are reported as ⚠ stale so the record cannot rot silently (they do not fail the gate — after merge the justified findings disappear by design, so prune matched entries then). Kinds that can never be justified: new-tautology, new-skip, new-extended-tautology, deleted-replacement-invalid — these always fail. Evidence refs are commits and greppable observations, not prose for the test files.

justifications.reason: The test statically inspects .github/workflows/electron-release.yml and electron/main.js to guard electron-updater latest.yml staging; neither the electron workflow nor the electron/ directory exists in this fork at base or HEAD (Electron-shell prune), so the file it guards is absent by design.
evidence: git ls-tree 89469f72 .github/workflows/ → 8 files, no electron-release.yml; ls .github/workflows @HEAD → same 8
no electron/ directory at HEAD (ls electron → not found); package.json workspaces = ["open-sse"]
base file header: 'This test statically inspects .github/workflows/electron-release.yml'

evidence: grep -rn resolveContextRoute src tests @HEAD → no hits
src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/context/page.tsx:5 — 'Previously this route redirected to `/dashboard/context/settings`' (resolver removed by design)
base file: `const { resolveContextRoute } = await import(".../context/page.tsx")` — cannot resolve at HEAD

grep -n -- '--color-card:' src/app/globals.css → single line 41 '#ffffff' (same single line at base 89469f72) — literals #161b22 and var(--color-card) match nothing
HEAD tests/integration/integration-wiring.test.ts:284-292 — matchAll over every definition, assert.ok(cardTokens.length > 0), per-token opaque-hex assert with message

justifications.reason: e815a677 removed 2 assert.doesNotThrow(async () => …) wrappers: node's doesNotThrow returns before the promise settles, so they asserted nothing about async failure; the tests now await the calls directly (a rejection fails at the call site) and keep every downstream result assert.
evidence: commit e815a677 fix(async): close the remaining sync-vs-Promise seams in reads and writes
in-file comment: 'a synchronous doesNotThrow(async fn) returns immediately and asserts before the assignment lands. Await directly — an unexpected throw still fails the test at this line'
both tests retain their assert.equal(result!.deletedRows, …) outcome asserts

justifications.reason: 6cd15726 removed 3 discoverManifests inclusion asserts for electron/package.json and the two @omniroute/* shells — none of them are npm workspaces (package.json workspaces = ['open-sse'] at base and HEAD; electron/ deleted), so the asserts pin paths discoverManifests can never return.
evidence: commit 6cd15726 test: fix stale workspace/brand assertions and unawaited async usage reads
package.json workspaces → ["open-sse"] (verified at base 89469f72 and HEAD); no electron/ directory at HEAD
in-file comment: 'electron/ and the @omniroute/* shells were removed by the Electron-shell prune; only open-sse remains a workspace'

justifications.reason: 560ab166 re-pinned the guard to the post-rewrite mechanism: the .dashboard-sidebar-desktop class does not exist in globals.css at base or HEAD (grep → 0), so the 3 old CSS-presence asserts were false; they were replaced by one absence assert plus exact pins on the hidden md:flex / md:hidden cascade pair in DashboardLayout.tsx.

grep -c dashboard-sidebar-desktop src/app/globals.css → 0 at HEAD and 0 at base 89469f72
HEAD test asserts className="hidden md:flex", the md:hidden overlay pairing, and assert.doesNotMatch for the orphaned CSS class

justifications.reason: 08da0d03 removed 1 assert.doesNotThrow(() => saveRequestDetailLog(…)) — the helper is async and doesNotThrow never awaits its rejection; the direct await at the same spot fails the test on rejection, and the missing-table tolerance stays pinned by the 4 subsequent awaited result asserts.
evidence: commit 08da0d03 test(db): join the migration barrier and await async reads
in-file comment: 'The helper must SWALLOW the missing-table error rather than reject: it is called from the hot request path'
assert.deepEqual(await getRequestDetailLogs(), []), count==0 and the two get-by-id null asserts retained after the await

justifications.reason: e73819e1 removed 1 assert.doesNotThrow(() => ensureProviderConnectionsColumns(db)) — the reconciler now awaits DDL and returns a promise doesNotThrow never awaited; the plain await at the same spot fails on rejection and the quota_visible/notnull/dflt_value outcome asserts after it are unchanged.
evidence: commit e73819e1 fix(db): await the DDL in the schema-column reconcilers
HEAD test lines 74 and 85: 'await ensureProviderConnectionsColumns(db);'
post-await asserts retained: quota_visible hasColumn true/false, column.notnull==1, column.dflt_value=='1'

justifications.reason: a9a33dac removed 3 assert.doesNotThrow(() => { result = translateRequest(…) }) wrappers — doesNotThrow does not await the returned promise, so rejections escaped the guard entirely; each test now does 'result = await result' so any throw fails it, with all downstream message/order asserts kept.

each of the 3 tests awaits the translateRequest call directly before asserting messages
assert.ok(Array.isArray(messages)), role/order asserts retained in all 3 tests
